description: This file contains unit tests for various utility functions and components in the OpenClaw project, including age formatting, SSH target parsing, connection settings, gateway entry point determination, and log file location logic.

methods.name: age strings cover common windows
methods.description: Test for age formatting of timestamps.

methods.name: parse SSH target supports user port and defaults
methods.description: Test for parsing SSH target strings with and without specified ports.

methods.name: sanitized target strips leading SSH prefix
methods.description: Test for cleaning SSH target strings and retrieving connection settings.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint prefers dist over bin
methods.description: Test for selecting the correct gateway entry point file based on file existence.

methods.name: log locator picks newest log file
methods.description: Test for identifying the most recent log file in a directory.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint nil when missing
methods.description: Test for the absence of a gateway entry point when no files are present.
